def factor_drawdown_depth_atr(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    peak = df_copy["close"].rolling(63, min_periods=63).max()
    dd = (df_copy["close"] - peak) / peak
    depth = (-dd)
    atr_63 = talib.ATR(df_copy["high"], df_copy["low"], df_copy["close"], timeperiod=63)
    normalized_depth = depth / atr_63.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = normalized_depth.fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr"]
